source: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 85 for the uses below (live: the slabs' column; frameLive: the frames'; seismicLive: the seismic force's). The other uses keep the parent's ASCE 7-22 values (their rows name it) and count in W by the seismic table's liveShare. The column load reduction by the number of floors carried (Art. 85(2)) is not covered.
